# basistheory_proxy (Resource)

Proxy https://docs.basistheory.com/docs/api/proxies/pre-configured-proxies

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "basistheory_proxy" "my_proxy" {
  name            = "My Proxy"
  destination_url = "https://httpbin.org/post"
}

# Proxy with Request Transforms - processes incoming requests
resource "basistheory_proxy" "request_transform_proxy" {
  name            = "Request Transform Proxy"
  destination_url = "https://api.example.com/payments"
  require_auth    = true

  # Request transforms - executed in order on incoming requests
  request_transforms {
    # Tokenize credit card data from request
    type = "tokenize"
    options = {
      identifier = "requestCardToken"
      token = jsonencode({
        type = "card"
        data = "{{ encrypted | json: '$.data' }}"
        metadata = {
          source = "proxy-request"
        }
      })
    }
  }
}

# Proxy with Response Transforms - processes outgoing responses
resource "basistheory_proxy" "response_transform_proxy" {
  name            = "Response Transform Proxy"
  destination_url = "https://api.bank.com/accounts"
  require_auth    = true

  # Response transforms - executed in order on outgoing responses
  response_transforms {
    # Tokenize sensitive account data from response
    type = "tokenize"
    options = {
      identifier = "responseAccountToken"
      token = jsonencode({
        type = "card"
        data = {
          "number" : "{{ res.number }}",
          "cvc" : "{{ res.cvc }}",
          "expiration_month" : "{{ res.expiration_month }}",
          "expiration_year" : "{{ res.expiration_year }}"
        },
        metadata = {
          source = "proxy-response"
        }
      })
    }
  }

  response_transforms {
    # Replace account number with token ID in response JSON
    type = "append_json"
    options = {
      value    = "{{ transform_identifier: 'responseAccountToken' | json: '$.id' }}"
      location = "$.tokenized_account_id"
    }
  }

  response_transforms {
    # Add response header with token reference
    type = "append_header"
    options = {
      value    = "{{ transform_identifier: 'responseAccountToken' | json: '$.id' }}"
      location = "X-Account-Token-ID"
    }
  }
}

# Proxy with a code Request Transform on the node24 runtime,
# with an execution role and runtime logs
resource "basistheory_proxy" "code_transform_proxy" {
  name            = "Code Transform Proxy"
  destination_url = "https://api.example.com/payments"
  require_auth    = true

  request_transforms {
    type = "code"
    code = <<-EOT
    module.exports = async function (context) {
      return context;
    };
    EOT

    options {
      runtime {
        image     = "node24"
        timeout   = 10
        resources = "standard"

        # The access the code runs with: `permissions` or `rule` blocks
        execution_role {
          permissions = ["token:read"]
        }

        # Without this block logs are off, and logs turned on outside Terraform
        # are turned off on the next apply
        logs {
          enabled = true
          level   = "info"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

output "proxy_key" {
  value       = basistheory_proxy.my_proxy.key
  description = "My proxy key"
  sensitive   = true
}

output "request_proxy_key" {
  value       = basistheory_proxy.request_transform_proxy.key
  description = "Request transform proxy key"
  sensitive   = true
}

output "response_proxy_key" {
  value       = basistheory_proxy.response_transform_proxy.key
  description = "Response transform proxy key"
  sensitive   = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `destination_url` (String) Destination URL for the Proxy
- `name` (String) Name for the Proxy

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) The Application's API key used in the BasisTheory instance passed into the Proxy Transform
- `configuration` (Map of String) Configuration for the Reactor
- `disable_detokenization` (Boolean) When true, disables all detokenization processing and passes detokenization expressions through as literal text
- `encrypted` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded encrypted token request data
- `request_transforms` (Block List) Request transforms for the Proxy (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--request_transforms))
- `require_auth` (Boolean) Require auth for the Proxy
- `response_transforms` (Block List) Response transforms for the Proxy (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--response_transforms))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp at which the Proxy was created
- `created_by` (String) Identifier for who created the Proxy
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Proxy
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Key for the Proxy
- `modified_at` (String) Timestamp at which the Proxy was last updated
- `modified_by` (String) Identifier for who last modified the Proxy
- `state` (String) Current state of the Proxy
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant identifier where this Proxy was created

Optional:

- `location` (String) Location for append transforms
- `runtime` (Block List, Max: 1) Runtime configuration for code transforms (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--request_transforms--options--runtime))
- `token` (String) Token configuration for tokenize transforms (JSON string)
- `value` (String) Value for append transforms

<a id="nestedblock--request_transforms--options--runtime"></a>
### Nested Schema for `request_transforms.options.runtime`

Optional:

- `dependencies` (Map of String)
- `execution_role` (Block List, Max: 1) Execution role: the access the code runs with, set through `permissions` or `rule` blocks. Declare it here before, or together with, setting it through the API, Portal or CLI: when the `runtime` block is set and this block is omitted, an execution role set elsewhere is removed on the next apply that updates the resource. Provider versions that do not have this block remove it the same way, so upgrade before setting one (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--request_transforms--options--runtime--execution_role))
- `image` (String)
- `logs` (Block List, Max: 1) Runtime logs. When the `runtime` block is set and this block is omitted, logs are off at level `info`: logs turned on outside Terraform, or a level other than `info` set there, are reset on the next apply that updates the resource. To keep them, add this block before applying (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--request_transforms--options--runtime--logs))
- `permissions` (List of String, Deprecated) List of permissions for the code transform. Use `permissions` inside an `execution_role` block instead; this attribute keeps working
- `resolutions` (Map of String)
- `resources` (String)
- `timeout` (Number)
- `warm_concurrency` (Number)

<a id="nestedblock--request_transforms--options--runtime--execution_role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `request_transforms.options.runtime.execution_role`

Optional:

- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions granted to the execution role
- `rule` (Block Set, Max: 20) Access rules granted to the execution role (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--request_transforms--options--runtime--execution_role--rule))

<a id="nestedblock--request_transforms--options--runtime--execution_role--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `request_transforms.options.runtime.execution_role.rule`

Required:

- `container` (String) The container of Tokens this rule is scoped to
- `description` (String) A description of this Access Rule
- `permissions` (Set of String) List of permissions to grant on this Access Rule
- `priority` (Number) The priority of this Access Rule, beginning with 1 and higher values having lower precedence
- `transform` (String) The transform to apply to accessed Tokens



<a id="nestedblock--request_transforms--options--runtime--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `request_transforms.options.runtime.logs`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether runtime logs are captured. Defaults to false, so a block that only sets `level` captures nothing
- `level` (String) Level captured, together with every more severe level: `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`. Defaults to `info`
